The text is largely illegible gibberish, mimicking the layout of food items and descriptions. There are decorative swirls at the top left and a small circular graphic on the right side. The lighting is warm and slightly uneven, casting soft shadows.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The primary artifact is the complete failure to render legible text. The characters are malformed, merge into each other, and do not form any known alphabet or language, which is a hallmark of AI generation struggling with typography.
The decorative lines appear slightly 'melted' into the background texture rather than sitting sharply on top of the paper grain.
The small circular graphic lacks defined edges and internal structure, appearing as a vague smudge rather than a distinct logo or illustration.

alignment_reasoning: The image captures the general 'vibe' and physical materiality of a rustic menu (texture, layout approximation), but fails critically on the defining functional components: legible text and structured information. It looks like a menu from a distance but falls apart upon inspection due to gibberish text.
artifact_reasoning: Severe text gibberish artifacts dominate the image, rendering the core function of the object (reading) impossible. Additionally, minor structural issues in the decorative elements and icons indicate generative weaknesses in rendering sharp, distinct graphical details.
